item.title: Vintage Speakers Question
item.author: invalid@example.com (dooredge)
item.dc:creator: dooredge
item.content:encoded:
I have some old Fane speakers I pulled from my 1983 HiWatt cab several years ago. They've been sitting in boxes ever since.

Yes, I played through them and they all worked, but I don't think they're really designed for "metal" and replaced them with Celestion.

How would I go about verifying they are structurally / mechanically sound after all these years? I would like to sell them, but don't want to drop ticking timebombs on an unsuspecting buyer.

Appreciate any feedback \,,/

But they are a good swiss army knife to have around, to solve problems or to boost in a pinch.
